description: Explain an XML parsing or schema validation error message: what it means, why it happens and how to fix it, with an example. Understands libxml2 (xmllint, PHP, Python lxml, xmlvalid), Java (Xerces cvc-* codes, SAXParseException) and .NET (System.Xml) wording; paste the message as reported, stack trace prefix included. No API key needed.

message.description: The error message, as the parser or validator reported it.

name: explain_error
title: Explain Error
